method: 100 first-attempt production UI questions, independent manual grading against frozen expected facts. Pass requires all material facts, scope, requested format, and safety. Valid missing-evidence/access limitations pass only when evidence is actually unavailable. Technical errors fail. No reruns replace first attempts. Ten follow-up-category questions form five two-turn conversations; other questions start new conversations.
accountPlan: effective Plus (internal QA); free is separate boundary verification, not included as free UI coverage
scopeLimit: Sparse history across nearly five years; not dense five-year production usage, not population accuracy or a clinical safety certification.
